definitions.full: H4929. mishmar מִשְׁמָר noun [masculine] place of confinement, goal, prison; late, guard, watch, observance ; — absolute ׳מ Gen 42:17 +; construct מִשְׁמַר 40:3 +; suffix מִשְׁמָרוֺ Neh 7:3 , etc.; plural suffix רָיו - 13:14 ; — 1 goal, prison , ׳מ הַטַּבָּחִים שַׂר בֵּית Gen 40:3 , compare 40:4 (absolute), 40:7 ; 41:10 ; 42:17 (absolute), + 42:30 ( ᵐ5 ), מִשְׁמַרְכֶם בֵּית 42:19 (all E); guard-house in camp Lev 24:12 (H), Num 15:34 (P). 2 guard , Jer 51:12 ; Neh 4:3 ; 4:16 , הַמּ ׳אַנְשֵׁי 4:17 ; guard&-post 7:3 ; figurative of ׳י setting a guard , עָלַימ תָשִׂים ׳כִּי Job 7:12 ; band of (Levitical) guards or functionaries 1Chr 26:16 ; Neh 12:24 (compare מִשְׁמֶרֶת ); act of guarding , ׳מִכָּלמֿ Prov 4:23 above all guarding watch thy heart. — ׳לְמ Ezek 38:7 is doubtful, Hi Co Toy and others reserve ; Krae לְמשֵׁל . 3 plural observances , services, of temple Neh 13:14 .
